title: Void Swarm Weapon Evolutions: How Evolving Works Step by Step
subtitle: Max out a weapon, find its passive and watch a basic gun turn into something much bigger.
description: How do weapon evolutions work in Void Swarm? Max out a weapon, pair it with the matching passive and evolve it. Examples, slots and when to commit.
card: How weapon evolutions work in Void Swarm: the max-level plus matching passive rule, example pairings, slot limits and how to plan a build.

faq.q: How do weapon evolutions work in Void Swarm?
faq.a: Max out a weapon, then own the matching passive. When both conditions are met, an Evolution card appears among your level-up choices and the weapon turns into a stronger version. There are 10 evolutions in the game.

Each evolving weapon has one matching passive. For example, the Blaster evolves with Overclock into the Nova Blaster, the Saw with Plating into the Ripper, and Gravity Well shows its partner, Attractor, on its card.

faq.q: Do I lose anything when a weapon evolves?
faq.a: The evolved weapon replaces the base weapon in its slot, so you do not spend an extra slot on it. You do need to commit passive and weapon slots to the pair, so plan the build before your slots fill up.
